en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a rural landscape with cultivated fields, rows of trees, and a small cluster of farm buildings with a tall smokestack or chimney in the background. The foreground is open farmland; the horizon shows low wooded areas and distant fields. The lower part of the card is blank except for red printed German text in the center and publisher information printed vertically along the left edge.
